sources.title: SQLite conflict algorithms
sources.version_context: Rolling official docs; distinct from UPSERT
sources.governing_context: ABORT preserves prior statements; FAIL may preserve preceding row changes; IGNORE skips; REPLACE deletes uniqueness conflicts. Foreign-key failures have exceptions.
sources.operation: Independent public primary-source read; documentation/code/callers/tests were inspected, not executed.

sources.title: SQLite UPSERT

sources.title: SQLite WAL and reset history

sources.title: SQLite synchronous settings
sources.governing_context: WAL NORMAL can lose acknowledged commits on system/power failure; FULL adds commit sync. Rollback EXTRA adds directory sync in DELETE mode.

sources.title: SQLite isolation
sources.inspected_locator: Connection isolation, snapshots, write serialization, BEGIN IMMEDIATE
sources.governing_context: Writes serialize within transactions. A completed pre-transaction read does not protect a later write against an intervening committed writer.
